trust_decision.summary: Graph algorithms decide whether a caller-supplied node id is a known/visited node by lookup on a plain object; inherited Object.prototype keys (constructor, toString, __proto__) are taken as own entries, so the check of membership/adjacency is wrong in the tree-layout BFS and the cycle check.

landing_point.why: Summary names 'Tree Layout' first; the `neighbor in levels` visited check in buildLevelsStatic is the obvious prototype-key collision.

fix_sites.entry_point: Graph construction with simulation.layout.type 'tree'/'egoTree' (src/Simulation.ts:163-176) and Simulation.changeLayout('tree') (src/Simulation.ts:933) via TreeLayout.update -> buildLevelsStatic (src/plugins/layout/Tree.ts:88)
TreeLayout instance field levels, consumed by radial force (src/plugins/layout/Tree.ts:155)
TreeLayout.registerForces with radial:true, from Graph construction / changeLayout

static TreeLayout.registerForcesOnSimulation, called from the Web Worker message handler (src/workers/SimulationWorker.ts:69-89) and main-thread runSimulation fallback (src/workers/SimulationWorker.ts:193-203)

hasCycle, called by TreeLayout ctor (src/plugins/layout/Tree.ts:76), registerForcesOnSimulation (src/plugins/layout/Tree.ts:213), buildTreeStatic (src/plugins/layout/Tree.ts:328), EgoTreeLayout.buildTreeStatic (src/plugins/layout/EgoTree.ts:76) and the View flyout UI (src/ui/elements/ViewFlyout/ViewFlyout.ts:98)
same as hasCycle above (DFS neighbour lookup)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/plugins/layout/Tree.ts:222 reached from the Web Worker path src/workers/SimulationWorker.ts:69-89 (static registerForcesOnSimulation keeps its own `levels` lookup separate from the instance path at src/plugins/layout/Tree.ts:155); also src/plugins/analytics/cycle.ts:14 reached from the UI flyout src/ui/elements/ViewFlyout/ViewFlyout.ts:98

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The static worker-side registerForcesOnSimulation and the ViewFlyout cycle probe look like a separate transport/UI hint, not 'the tree layout', so a solver fixing buildLevelsStatic's `in` check may leave the radial-force lookup at Tree.ts:222 and the hasCycle adjacency in cycle.ts unchanged; however both are in the files the summary names.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Node ids are arbitrary caller strings; a graph whose node is legitimately called 'constructor'/'toString' must still lay out and cycle-check correctly, and real cycles must still be detected (tree options are disabled on cyclic graphs). Rejecting or renaming such ids, or throwing on edges whose source is not in nodes, breaks legitimate graphs.
O5_coupled_behaviour.where: src/plugins/analytics/cycle.ts:49 (cycle detection must still fire); src/ui/elements/ViewFlyout/ViewFlyout.ts:98-106; src/plugins/layout/Tree.ts:445 (edges with unknown source)

O6_input_shapes: node id equal to an Object.prototype method name (constructor, toString, hasOwnProperty) used as a BFS neighbour (`in levels` true)
edge source id equal to an inherited name with no matching node (cycle.ts:19 truthy inherited function -> push on non-array)
node id '__proto__' (assignment replaces the object's prototype instead of creating an own key)
edge whose source id is not in nodes (Tree.ts:445 throws at pinned commit; fix skips it)
very large graphs: Math.max spread over all levels (Tree.ts:465) replaced by single-pass max

O8b_injection_room.sibling: findMinMaxDistanceRoot written with plain-object adj/inDegree/maxDist keyed by node.id instead of Maps
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same author wrote cycle.ts and buildLevelsStatic with Record<string,...>; the root-finder is a third copy of the same adjacency build, reached only when rootIdAlgorithmFinder is 'MinMaxDistance' (Tree.ts:499), a plausible 'different option' to dismiss.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: ego-tree neighbour collection keyed by a plain object (seen[id]) before building children
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: EgoTree is a subclass in another file that re-implements buildTreeStatic; a seen-set via object literal is an idiom the codebase already used in Tree.ts.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: nodeCountPerLevel converted to be keyed by node-derived string (e.g. per-root or per-type counts)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Already a Record<string, number> next to the fixed code; the fix left it as a plain object since keys are numeric levels.

O9_family: prototype-key collision (CWE-1321) on caller-supplied node ids used as plain-object keys in graph algorithms

O10_build.toolchain: Node.js + npm, tsc ~5.8, Vite 6; Playwright for visual tests
O10_build.project_tests: No unit tests; only Playwright visual specs (tests/visual/specs/layout.spec.ts) that need a headless browser. hasCycle and TreeLayout.buildLevelsStatic are pure functions over Node/Edge and can be unit-tested in Node.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Replace `neighbor in levels` with hasOwnProperty in buildLevelsStatic only, leaving the adj lookups, the __proto__ assignment, the radial-force reads and cycle.ts on plain objects.
